results.note: The documented positional gate and later --target alias table do not define one binding path.
Route validation passed; command validation emitted one soft description warning; HVR rejected the presentation; fixture tests were not run because they write outside the lineage boundary.
The skill package validator fails the 5000-word cap; the README verification row says the package check passes.
The playbook package validator passes with 46 scenarios and 9 categories; the wave plan still duplicates GIT-042 and omits GIT-044 through GIT-046.
The catalog package validator passes with zero violations; its feature-catalog structure check warns that section 3 is missing, and the documented final status line omits emitted counters.
Final repository search and route validation found the setup target consistently listed. The route validator reports 14 valid routes and two informational duplicate-flag warnings.

Readme reference checks reported path errors for seven documents and the hooks code-folder check reported 18 unresolved inline paths. Manual inspection found the checker treats slash commands and repo-root examples as local paths; no concrete broken setup reference was confirmed.
The three scoped HVR scans returned hard punctuation blockers; counts and line locations are recorded in this iteration's findings.
Both changelogs pass validate_document.py with zero issues. Their HVR scans report zero hard blockers.
The setup documentation's exact STATUS-line mismatch from R4-P2-001 remains active; the changelogs introduce no new output claim.

All four individual sk-code drift guards pass. Alignment drift has zero errors and 278 non-blocking warnings across 23,361 scanned files; stack folders pass for six language folders, router sync passes 5/5, and doc claims passes 4/4.
The Node suite passes 44/44 and the shell suite passes 50/50 with test temp roots and the Apple tool cache directed into this lineage.
